summary: Verified all four Staff Onboarding bug fixes end-to-end (HR modal overlay/scroll, PDF spacing endpoint, Policies READ-then-acknowledge, Submit checklist/validation). Backend pytest 5/5 pass; frontend Playwright confirmed portalised full-viewport modals for case-detail/template-manager/pack-settings and the new-starter portal policies + submit flow.

verifications.HR modal (case-detail, template-manager,: createPortal → document.body; overlay position=fixed inset-0 covering full 1920x1080; z-index 300; rgba(0,0,0,0.7); body.style.overflow locked to 'hidden'; Escape key closes; backdrop mousedown closes; sticky header × still works. Verified 3 modals opened/closed successfully.
verifications.Pack PDF: GET /api/staff-onboarding/cases/{id}/pack.pdf → 200, content-type application/pdf, starts with %PDF-, size >1500 bytes. Header spacing verified visually by main agent (title / name / status line separated).
verifications.New-Starter Policies READ: Portal loads, sign-in with password (min 8) works, /new-starter/<token> portal shows 5 policies. Un-acknowledged rows show 'Read policy' (nsp-read-<key>). Clicking opens nsp-modal (full-viewport 1920x1080 portal-to-body, z-300) with policy body text visible (nsp-policy-body ~158 chars). 'I have read & acknowledge' (nsp-ack-<key>) closes modal and flips row to 'Acknowledged ✓'.
verifications.New-Starter Submit validation: nsp-submit-checklist shows all 4 items (details/policies/agreements required + documents recommended). When required items outstanding: submit button DISABLED, nsp-submit-reason lists exactly what is missing (`You can't submit yet — please complete: Your details…, Company policies acknowledged, Agreements signed.`). Warn banner (nsp-submit-warn) present in code for docs-only-missing scenario. Submitted banner (nsp-submitted-banner) present in code.
verifications.Regression: HR console loads (staff-onboarding-console), case rows clickable, Templates/Settings modals open. Portal offer/contract/agreements/PDF sections still render (data-testids nsp-offer-pdf, nsp-contract-pdf, nsp-sign-<key> all present in code).

critical_code_review_comments: Modal ({wide} branch in StaffOnboarding.js line 913) and PortalModal (NewStarterPortal.js line 225) share nearly identical logic — small DRY opportunity to extract a shared portal-modal primitive across the two files (non-blocking).
StaffOnboarding.js is 947 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline; consider splitting sub-modals (CaseDetail/TemplateManager/SettingsModal) into their own files in a future pass.
staff_onboarding_wizard.py is 1880 lines — well over 700-line guideline; recommend splitting into sub-routers (cases, invites, offers, contracts, activation, portal) for maintainability.
DELETE /api/staff-onboarding/cases/{id} returns 405 — no cleanup endpoint exists for HR to remove abandoned/test cases. Not part of this bugfix scope but worth adding.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 test cases (TEST BugFix<uuid> + NSP Test<uuid>) via API + one portal invitation. DELETE endpoint returns 405 so cases remain in db.staff_onboarding_cases prefixed with TEST_/NSP for easy identification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file at tests/test_staff_onboarding_bugfix_jan2026.py covers pack.pdf, list, invite, templates, settings, dashboard endpoints. No delete API for onboarding cases — best-effort teardown skipped. Auth returns 'token' (not 'access_token') for /api/auth/login.
